headline: Strongpoint Battles Flare Anew Across the Front
war_summary: Since the last edition, the Weathered Expanse has become the sharpest sector: eleven strategic-base events in the latest two-hour watch, the strongest two-hour count among all regions, and twenty-eight for the day. Linn Mercy and DeadLands each logged three events in that same interval, with Callahan's Gate again active in DeadLands. Godcrofts, quiet at the previous filing, has produced one further event and still leads every region with seventy-three changes over the past day. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle have gone quiet in the final two-hour reading but remain closely divided, with nine and five events respectively over the last six hours. Farranac Coast shows heavy casualties and sharpened enlistment, although no strongpoint has changed there for more than five hours; Fisherman's Row has brought no change for more than eight. Mooring County also reports elevated fighting without a fresh strategic-base exchange. The campaign still lacks a declared winner.
